getCurrentUser(); if (!$currentUser) { header('Location: signin.php'); exit; } try { require_once 'config/database.php'; $database = new Database(); $db = $database->getConnection(); // Get fresh data from database $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM students WHERE id = ?"); $stmt->execute([$currentUser['id']]); $freshUserData = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC); if ($freshUserData) { // Update session with fresh data $_SESSION['user'] = $freshUserData; echo "

Profile Data Refreshed

"; echo "

Session data has been updated with fresh database information.

"; echo "

Updated Profile Status:

"; echo "

Profile Completed: " . ($freshUserData['profile_completed'] ? 'YES' : 'NO') . "

"; echo "

Course: " . ($freshUserData['course'] ?: 'NOT SET') . "

"; echo "

Year Level: " . ($freshUserData['year_level'] ?: 'NOT SET') . "

"; $profileCompleted = $freshUserData['profile_completed']; $hasCourse = !empty($freshUserData['course']); $hasYearLevel = !empty($freshUserData['year_level']); $shouldShowBanner = (!$profileCompleted || !$hasCourse || !$hasYearLevel); echo "

Banner Status:

"; echo "

"; echo $shouldShowBanner ? "Banner SHOULD be visible" : "Banner should be HIDDEN"; echo "

"; echo "

Go to Dashboard

"; } else { echo "

Error: Could not fetch user data from database.

"; } } catch (Exception $e) { echo "

Error: " . $e->getMessage() . "

"; } ?>
